title: SREV-326 Secure BITS/WUAU AccessCheckByType bypass
stage: data -> schema -> topology -> logic -> action -> verify
contracts: official access-check semantics are descriptor, token, object-type, and generic mapping decisions
MAXIMUM_ALLOWED is not equivalent to blindly granting GenericAll
the BITS/WUAU branch is a local compatibility bypass, not a proven access-check implementation
the bypass is limited to BITS, Sandboxie WUAU, and wuauclt images
allowlisted callers must try Ldr_TestToken plus native __sys_NtAccessCheckByType before using the synthetic compatibility grant
synthetic MAXIMUM_ALLOWED to GenericAll fallback is allowed only when the native API call itself fails
all other callers must continue through Ldr_TestToken and native __sys_NtAccessCheckByType
runtime matrix must cover Windows versions, allowlisted callers, non-allowlisted callers, DesiredAccess shapes, security descriptors, token shapes, output contracts, and regression evidence
SREV-326 adds a native access-check first path while preserving the synthetic compatibility fallback
SREV-326 and SREV-327 share docs/plan/srev-326-327-secure-runtime-capture.schema.json as the machine-readable Windows evidence shape
runtime_gate: BITS/WUAU/WUAUCLT compatibility matrix on Windows 8.1+ and Windows 10/11, with allowlisted caller proof, non-allowlisted caller negative controls, allow/deny/NULL/owner-specific/object-type security descriptors, specific/generic/MAXIMUM_ALLOWED desired access, sandboxed/real/admin/non-admin token shapes, GrantedAccess/AccessStatus/LastError/return-status readback, and native forwarding regression
